reasons.description: The produced record cannot satisfy its declared output contract.
The requested action requires approval or is outside the active capability policy.
A declared dependency is unavailable and may be retried within budget.
The bounded operation exceeded its time allowance.
A permitted tool returned a failure and may be retried within budget.
A run, step, retry, tool-call, time, token, or spend limit was exceeded.
Execution was stopped by a supported cancellation or kill trigger.
An unclassified failure is fail-closed and not retried automatically.
